summary: CarParts.com filed an 8-K on June 15, 2026, announcing the entry into a Loan and Security Agreement with First Business Specialty Finance, LLC for a $25 million asset-based revolving credit facility. The facility is secured by company assets, matures March 31, 2028, with automatic renewals, and interest at 1-month SOFR + 3.25% subject to reduction based on fixed charge coverage ratio. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
